label: Schema model of the Catholicism case signature
term: schema model of the Catholicism case signature
definition: A particular Signature value constructed in Lean to witness satisfiability, an omission or the independence of a premise (for example TruthCore.Case.Catholicism.StageThree.DivineFounding.modelSig, Round3ChristChurch.jσ and nσ, or a signature introduced by an existential ∃ σ : Signature in a model theorem). What holds in such a model is a fact about the formal schema at that value, not about the intended interpretation of the case vocabulary.
note: Recorded as the contrasting sense to the intended interpretation so that a model witness is never read as a claim about the case's intended σ (AGENTS.md, 'existence of a witness versus properties of the particular witness'). No binder is tagged with this sense: model signatures are constructed values or existentially bound, not parameters of case propositions. A sense-1 tag reads a declaration's binder only in its role as the corpus statement. Applying the same declaration to a constructed model value is a sense-2 use, for example CapacityBridge (modelSignature true) … in TruthCore/Alternatives/ReligiousExperienceRecognition.lean (lines 87–99) or NecessaryRootBoxK noGodSignature … in TruthCore/Causality/LogicalNecessityProfiles.lean (line 136). A theorem proved over an arbitrary σ applies to the intended interpretation (sense 1) only by instantiating it there.
